response.justification: While Bogdan is an exceptionally talented software engineer with 19 years of diverse experience and strong fundamentals in system design and craftsmanship, he represents a poor fit for this C++ specialist role. He has only ~6 months of professional C++ experience (2014-2015) and has spent the last decade in web/full-stack technologies (Node.js, TypeScript, React). The role requires expert-level C++, multi-threaded systems programming, industrial automation/IoT background, and security standards knowledge—none of which are demonstrated in his resume. His strengths in high-performance async systems don't translate directly to C++ systems programming, and he lacks exposure to the industrial domain entirely.
strengths: Exceptional software engineering fundamentals with 19 years of experience and proven ability to design high-performance systems handling millions of requests per second
Strong mentoring and teaching track record through workshops, code katas, and open-source contributions demonstrating ability to elevate team technical standards
Proven full-stack capability and adaptability across multiple languages and domains (DLang, Node.js, Java, C#), showing strong problem-solving mindset
concerns: Minimal C++ expertise with only ~6 months of professional experience (2014-2015) and no recent hands-on C++ work—role requires expert-level C++ and STL mastery
No demonstrated background in industrial automation, embedded systems, IoT protocols (MQTT, Modbus, IEC 61850), or security standards (SDL, IEC 62443)—all core to the role
Educational credentials show BS Computer Science rather than B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech; current focus on web/full-stack development diverges significantly from systems programming required

key_factors.factor: Long career with strong systems design capability
